name: Ichihara Tamoe
source:
The younger sister of the volleyball team captain, whom protagonist Hajime ends up coaching.

The youngest of the Ichihara sisters: eldest sister Moeko, second sister Moeka, and third sister Tamoe.

She sometimes calls herself “Tamotamo.”

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080922232536/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/mama/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
